summary_en: MUFG authorized acquisition of up to 70 million shares (0.62% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 200 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 to January 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
The Board of Directors of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group has authorized the acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to Article 156(1) of the Companies Act, based on the provisions of Article 44 of the company's Articles of Incorporation. The authorization permits the company to acquire up to 70 million shares of its common stock, representing 0.62% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum total amount of 200 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 through January 29, 2027, on an execution date basis.

The company has positioned treasury stock acquisition as a shareholder return measure that contributes to improving capital efficiency. The fundamental policy is to execute such acquisitions flexibly while taking into account business and capital conditions, opportunities for growth investments, and market environment including stock price. The acquisition supports the company's broader shareholder return policy, which prioritizes dividends while maintaining an optimal balance between capital soundness and investments for growth.
